description: Catch-all for GuardDuty findings at Medium/High/Critical severity not already covered by a curated rule (024-027). Visibility only, no automated response. MUST be updated whenever a new curated GuardDuty rule is added -- see 'Keeping this in sync' in docs/detection-rules.md, or the new finding type will double-fire (one signal from the curated rule, one from here).
playbook: GuardDuty finding not covered by a curated OpenCDR rule. Review in the GuardDuty console and triage manually.
